title: BIME Golden Reactions — AAM regression corpus
description: Curated set of named reactions used as a regression benchmark for the atom-atom mapping engine. Each entry carries a SMILES reaction string, the class, the expected mapping shape, and a public literature/textbook source. Expected bond-change shapes are tuned to the engine's current emission semantics; the corpus is a regression baseline, not an engine-independent ground truth. Test harness: tests/test_v2_0_x_golden_reactions.js.

schema.name: textbook / named-reaction name
schema.smiles: reaction SMILES (reactants > agents > products, with arrow)

expected.minMapping: minimum number of mapped reactant atoms
expected.minBondChanges: minimum number of bond-change events (formed + cleaved + orderChange)
expected.hasFormed: true if at least one 'formed' event expected
expected.hasCleaved: true if at least one 'cleaved' event expected
